The container half has a cup half in an interior top portion. The dispenser includes a reciprocal container half having a reciprocal exposed edge and a reciprocal closure member at the reciprocal exposed edge. The dispenser includes a sleeve bag on valve (SBoV) assembly in an interior of the container. The SBoV assembly includes a valve seat. The cup and the reciprocal cup support the valve seat to secure the SBoV assembly in the container.

The disclosure describes a dispenser configured for dispensing a pressurized material. The dispenser is formed from two cooperating container halves that are joined together to define an enclosed container for holding and supporting a pressurized dispensing assembly.

A first container half includes an exposed edge, a closure member, and a cup half located in an interior top portion of the container half. A reciprocal, or corresponding, container half is also provided. The reciprocal container half includes a reciprocal exposed edge, a reciprocal closure member, and a reciprocal cup half positioned to correspond with the cup half of the first container half.

The closure member of the first container half is configured to matingly engage with the reciprocal closure member of the reciprocal container half along the respective exposed edges. When the two closure members are engaged, the first container half and the reciprocal container half are attached to one another, thereby forming the complete container.

A sleeve bag-on-valve assembly is secured within the container. The assembly includes a valve seat that is supported by the cup half and the reciprocal cup half. In this manner, the cup structures within the joined container halves cooperate to hold the valve assembly in position inside the container, allowing the dispenser to store and dispense the pressurized material.
outputs.L4:
A dispenser for pressurized material is provided in which the outer container is formed from two mating container halves. Each container half includes exposed peripheral edges provided with closure members that cooperate with corresponding closure members on the other half. When the two halves are brought together, the closure members engage to secure the halves to one another and define a substantially enclosed container body.

Each container half also includes an interior cup half. When the container halves are joined, the interior cup halves align with one another to form a complete internal cup structure. This cup structure is positioned to receive and support a sleeve bag-on-valve assembly, which includes a flexible bag for holding the material to be dispensed and a valve assembly through which the material is released under pressure.

The sleeve bag-on-valve assembly is placed between the two container halves before the halves are closed. As the halves are mated, the cup halves come together around the valve region of the assembly. The joined cup halves define a support for the valve seat, holding the valve assembly in a stable and properly aligned position within the container. This arrangement helps prevent the valve assembly from shifting during handling, storage, or dispensing.

By securely retaining the valve assembly inside the container, the dispenser provides reliable operation when pressurized material is dispensed. The mating container halves simplify assembly, while the cooperating closure members and internal cup structure help maintain the integrity and positioning of the bag-on-valve system. The result is a pressurized dispensing container that effectively supports the valve assembly and allows controlled release of the material contained in the sleeve bag.

**The SBoV: A Key Pillar of Financial Stability**

The SBoV, commonly understood as the State Bank of Vietnam, plays a central role in guiding the country’s financial and monetary system. As Vietnam’s central bank, the SBoV is responsible for managing monetary policy, regulating banking activities, maintaining financial stability, and supporting sustainable economic growth.

One of the most important responsibilities of the SBoV is controlling inflation and ensuring the stability of the national currency. Through tools such as interest rates, credit regulations, and foreign exchange management, the SBoV helps create a stable environment for businesses, investors, and consumers.

The SBoV also supervises commercial banks and financial institutions to ensure that they operate safely and transparently. This oversight is essential for protecting depositors, strengthening public trust, and reducing risks within the banking sector. In a rapidly developing economy, effective banking supervision is especially important.

In recent years, the SBoV has also supported digital transformation in the financial industry. The growth of online banking, cashless payments, and financial technology has encouraged the SBoV to develop modern regulations that promote innovation while maintaining security.

Overall, the SBoV is a vital institution in Vietnam’s economic development. By balancing stability, regulation, and innovation, the SBoV helps support a stronger and more resilient financial future.

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a patent-style abstract for a dispenser for pressurized material using two mating container halves and a sleeve bag-on-valve assembly supported by cup halves.
counterfactuals.output: A dispenser for pressurized material includes a container formed from first and second mating container halves defining an interior cavity. A sleeve bag-on-valve assembly is received within the cavity and includes a flexible sleeve or bag coupled to a valve assembly for dispensing material stored therein under pressure. The valve assembly is supported by complementary cup halves positioned between the mating container halves, the cup halves cooperating to retain and align the valve assembly relative to the container. The container halves may be secured together around the cup halves to form a rigid outer housing while permitting the sleeve bag-on-valve assembly to be installed without conventional crimping to a one-piece can. Actuation of the valve assembly dispenses the pressurized material from the sleeve or bag through an outlet while the mating container halves and cup halves provide structural support, positioning, and protection for the bag-on-valve assembly.

A pressurized material dispenser comprising:

a container body formed from a first container half and a second container half attached together;

the first container half including a first interior cup portion and the second container half including a second interior cup portion, the first and second interior cup portions together defining an internal support structure; and

counterfactuals.prompt: Generate a concise patent specification summary for a split-container pressurized dispenser where mating closure members join two halves and internal cup portions hold a valve seat of an SBoV assembly.
counterfactuals.output: A pressurized dispenser includes first and second container halves joined along mating closure members to define an internal chamber for product and propellant. Each closure member includes a corresponding internal cup portion that cooperates, when the halves are assembled, to capture and support a valve seat of a suspended bag-on-valve (SBoV) assembly. The SBoV assembly includes a flexible product bag coupled to the valve seat and suspended within the chamber, with the surrounding chamber configured to contain pressurizing gas. The mating closure members provide a sealed structural interface between the container halves while positioning and retaining the valve seat without requiring a conventional one-piece mounting cup. Actuation of a valve stem opens the valve seat to dispense product from the flexible bag under pressure applied by the propellant. The split-container configuration facilitates assembly, material reduction, recyclability, and integration of the SBoV valve support directly into the container closure structure.

counterfactuals.prompt: Describe an embodiment of a dispenser for pressurized material including a container half, reciprocal container half, exposed edges with closure members, and a sleeve bag-on-valve assembly secured by cup halves.
counterfactuals.output:
An embodiment of a dispenser for pressurized material includes a container formed from two cooperating halves: a container half and a reciprocal container half. The two halves are configured to be joined together along opposed exposed edges to define an interior volume for receiving a pressurized-material dispensing assembly.

Each container half may include an exposed peripheral edge. Closure members are provided along the exposed edges so that the container half and the reciprocal container half can be secured together. The closure members may include interlocking formations, snap-fit elements, crimped portions, adhesive-bonding regions, welded seams, or other mating features that retain the halves in a closed configuration around the dispensing assembly.

Disposed within the joined container halves is a sleeve bag-on-valve assembly. The sleeve bag-on-valve assembly includes a flexible bag or sleeve for holding the material to be dispensed and a valve structure through which the material is selectively discharged. The valve may be mounted at an upper end of the assembly and arranged to communicate with an actuator or dispensing nozzle.

The sleeve bag-on-valve assembly is secured in position by a pair of cup halves. The cup halves cooperate around a portion of the bag-on-valve assembly, such as around the valve mounting region or sleeve support region, to retain the assembly within the container. When the container half and reciprocal container half are joined, the cup halves clamp or otherwise capture the sleeve bag-on-valve assembly, thereby preventing undesired movement of the assembly relative to the container.

In use, pressurized propellant may be contained in a space surrounding the sleeve or bag, while the product material is contained within the bag. Actuation of the valve permits the pressurized material to be dispensed from the bag through the valve and out of the dispenser, while the joined container halves and closure members provide structural support and containment.
counterfactuals.label: cf_5
